news.title: Could Cristiano Ronaldo Play with His Son at the 2030 World Cup? Father-Son Dream for Portugal Explained
news.lede: Could Cristiano Ronaldo play alongside his son Cristiano Ronaldo Jr for Portugal at the 2030 World Cup? It may sound like a far-fetched dream, but the possibility could become a reality if the pieces fall into place. Portugal will co-host the 2030 World Cup, and there is a chance the tournament could feature the extraordinary sight of Cristiano Ronaldo sharing the pitch with his son.Ronaldo, who has been included in new Portugal coach Jorge Jesus’ first squad for the upcoming Nations League matches, has made it clear that he intends to continue his international career beyond the 2026 World Cup.. Remarkable fitnessBy the time the 2030 tournament arrives, however, Ronaldo will be 45.

Chennai Spain men’s football team head coach Luis de la Fuente has signed a contract extension till 2032, the Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) said on Monday.

news.title: Spain extend De la Fuente contract until 2032 after World Cup triumph
news.lede: FILE PHOTO: Soccer Football - FIFA World Cup 2026 - Spain Victory Parade - Madrid, Spain - July 20, 2026 Spain coach Luis De La Fuente celebrates on the stage at Cibeles Square in Madrid after the victory parade as fans gather to celebrate winning the World Cup REUTERS/Ana Beltran/File Photo. MADRID, Sept 21 - Spain coach Luis de la Fuente has signed a six-year contract extension that will keep him in charge until the end of the 2032 European Championship, after leading the national team to the 2024 European Championship and 2026 World Cup titles. The Spanish FA (RFEF) ratified the agreement at an Executive Committee meeting in Madrid on Monday, giving formal approval to a renewal that had been agreed during the World Cup. De la Fuente and the RFEF president Rafael Louzan will hold a press conference later on Monday.

news.title: Philippines women’s national football team secures qualification for 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup
news.lede: News On AIR | March 19, 2026 1:13 PM. The Philippines women’s national football team have secured qualification for the 2027 FIFA Women’s World Cup after defeating the Uzbekistan women’s national football team 2-0 in a Women’s Asian Cup play-in match on the Gold Coast today. Angela Beard delivered a standout performance, opening the scoring early in the second half after earlier missed opportunities. She found the net in the 47th minute with a well-taken strike into the roof of the goal.

news.title: Messi, Ronaldo and Bangladesh’s ASEAN Cup: A longer international break, with plenty to watch
news.lede: Club football is taking a near-three-week pause, but there is no shortage of intrigue on the international stage. For the first time, the September and October FIFA windows have been merged into a single 16-day international period, running from September 21 to October 6. Major European clubs played their last match before the break on September 20 and will return to action on October 10, leaving supporters without club football for almost three weeks. National teams, meanwhile, will pack four matches into the extended window instead of the usual two.

news.title: England squad: Morgan Gibbs-White set to replace Cole Palmer for Nations League games
news.lede: Palmer and Rice both played for their clubs in their last Premier League games. Tino Livramento, Kobbie Mainoo, Cole Palmer, Marcus Rashford and Declan Rice have all pulled out of England's squad for forthcoming Nations League matches. Nottingham Forest midfielder Morgan Gibbs-White and Everton's James Garner have been called into the squad by manager Thomas Tuchel and will join the squad on Tuesday. Tuchel said on Friday that 26-year-old Gibbs-White, who has six international caps, was close to being included in the initial squad.

news.title: Spain coach De la Fuente gets new deal after World Cup success
news.lede: MADRID: Spain's World Cup-winning coach Luis de la Fuente is to sign a new contract keeping him in the role until 2032, the Spanish football federation (RFEF) announced on Monday.
